text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand hasn't been feeling well, so I
suggested going to the shrine to pray, but—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
It's true that lately... I haven't been in top shape.
...I haven't even caught a single fish on my recent trips...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
“Still... is this really okay...?
My slump is my own fault...
Yet here I am, praying to the gods...”
choice_data_list: It's important to rely on others too

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
T-That's true, but.
I just feel kind of hesitant...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Then just for fishing.
I'll pray for good luck.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (...Wait, how was I supposed to pray again...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(With this ladle... umm...
which hand am I supposed to wash first...?)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Bow, clap hands... Huh?
Did I forget to rinse my mouth...!?)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
choice_data_list: Did you make sure to pray properly?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
……I-It's no use anymore……
God has abandoned me……

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Cheval Grand loses her confidence
and slumps her shoulders...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, what a wonderful breeze...
This feeling, somewhere before...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, it was when I went fishing with Dad.
A pleasant breeze just like this was blowing...
and the catch turned out great, too...!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Did my fishing wish come true?
Even though I got the steps wrong...
Are the gods really this kind?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...I-I knew it...! I'll go pray
for my own slump too...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After that, perhaps thanks to praying earnestly, Cheval Grand was able to regain her form.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
……Whoa!
The weather suddenly…… A-And now it's raining……!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...I can't even fish like this...
Maybe I really have been abandoned..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand grew even more despondent.
Though I reassured her it was just a coincidence, she remained in a slump afterward...
